opening.argument: The presentation urges viewers to buy mining shares by linking a pool purchase, including a recommended $500 start, to passive income. It displays priced pools with Buy Now controls, mining durations, commissions, and re-purchase percentages, then directs viewers to pay through a wallet in Bitcoin Cash. It further presents auto-rebuy as a compounding mechanism, including a 100% re-purchase setting, and says the proceeds can eventually replace income. The purchase is also shown as pending, alongside a notice concerning deposit-recognition issues; the presentation does not establish their cause or outcome. These are paid mining returns presented through an escalating reinvestment structure, not merely a neutral service description.
